newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Waiting continues as Estonia shares ease further.
newsitem.headline: Waiting continues as Estonia shares ease further.

text.p: Another day of waiting kept volumes low and saw most stocks slip further on the Estonian bourse on Wednesday, dealers said.
The Talse index fell by 0.85 percent to close on 261.39 with 35.1 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"It was another slow day, with investors waiting and hoping the price slippage does not become a trend," one trader said.
"Investors are looking for a rise that will start again and are not prepared to sell just yet," another dealer added.
Hansapank turned over 15.6 million kroons of shares to be 1.70 kroons lower on 137.00 kroons.
"There were some big blocks registered at the end of the trading, but I think they were reported late, perhaps for this morning or yesterday," one dealer said.
Forekspank closed slightly higher at 190.70, up 2.50 kroons on a small trade of 8.8 million kroons.
"Foreskpank may hold but it is hard to tell because of the holiday tomorrow, but investors will have a chance to consider what they have been doing," another dealer said.
The over-the-counter market trade was down to 2.9 million kroons of trade with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma closed on 75.50 kroons, down 0.50 kroons, after turning over 1.4 million kroons.
